present.label: Read the log
present.story: The log has {n} symbols. We read them left to right and keep a pile of the compartments that are still open.
present.formal: len(log) = {n}. Scan left to right with a stack of unmatched openers.

initialize.label: Start empty
initialize.story: No compartments are open yet, so the pile is empty.

push.label: Push an opener
push.story: Position {index} opens a compartment, {char}. It goes on top of the pile and will need a {closer} lid. Open compartments: {depth}.
push.formal: log[{index}] = '{char}' is an opener: push it. Stack size {depth}.

pop-match.label: Pop a match
pop-match.story: Position {index} is a {char} lid. The most recently opened compartment is {opener} from position {openerIndex}, and the lid fits, so it comes off the pile.
pop-match.formal: log[{index}] = '{char}' matches the top '{opener}' (from index {openerIndex}): pop. Stack size {depth}.

mismatch.label: Mismatch
mismatch.story: Position {index} is a {char} lid, but the compartment opened most recently is {top} from position {topIndex}, which needs {expected}. The lids are crossed.
mismatch.formal: log[{index}] = '{char}' does not match the top '{top}' (it needs '{expected}'). Return False.

unmatched-close.label: Nothing to close
unmatched-close.story: Position {index} is a {char} lid, but no compartment is open.
unmatched-close.formal: log[{index}] = '{char}' with an empty stack. Return False.

leftover.label: Left open
leftover.story: The log has ended, but compartments are still open: {count}. The top one is {top}, from position {topIndex}.
leftover.formal: End of input with unmatched openers on the stack ({count}). Return False.

valid.label: All matched
valid.story: Every lid fit the most recent open compartment and nothing is left open. The crate is packed correctly.
valid.formal: End of input with an empty stack. Return True.
